title: NLTK: Quadratic-time DoS in SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline on an unterminated corpus line via per-iteration…
description: NLTK's SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline function has a performance issue where reading a single very long line without a newline character causes quadratic CPU usage due to repeated rescanning of an accumulating buffer. An attacker controlling the corpus file content can exploit this by providing a large unterminated line, causing significant CPU consumption and denial of service. The issue affects NLTK versions prior to 3.10.4 and has been fixed in version 3.10.4.
